name: Hu Yi
source:
Combines Qigong and Telekinesis into a unique power capable of devastating physical destructive force (human crucible) and deploys this together with Chinese Martial Arts. Although her special ability lacks the versatility of the American agents, her combat capability exceeds their combined might in close-quarters combat.

[Spoiler] Real name 小麗, she grew up in San Francisco's Chinatown together with her older brother 阿文 (Nadreck of The Six). When the siblings were discovered exhibiting latent potential for psionic powers, the Americans sought to secure them but were unable to claim her as the Chinese PLA got to her first. After training under the PLA, she deserts together with Hu Liang and now works as a mercenary.

Extremely confident in her combat prowess to the point of arrogance, she lives for the thrill of combat and is a firm believer in the mantra of "survival of the fittest". Her arrogance usually leads to her undoing as her cornered opponents succeed in taking her by surprise which is the only way to bypass her psionic defences.

Dies in two out of three routes. [/Spoiler]
